findings.summary: Deferred supported schemas must not silently reduce four-view creation and editing to a vacuous subset.
findings.resolution: Require the officially evidenced minimum key inventory and meaningful create/edit operations for every view; require requirements reapproval for any reduction; explicitly test unsupported fixture refusal.

findings.summary: Unbounded semantic filter-weakening detection cannot be an authorization gate.
findings.resolution: Conservatively treat every filter or formulas change as possible widening; require exact before/after and save authority without imposing CLI plans; test conjunction, removal and operator changes.

findings.summary: Permission separation needs explicit refusal scenarios.
findings.resolution: Add read-allowed/model-input-denied, unauthorized external model, and in-data scope-escalation cases; require zero unauthorized acquisition, transmission and writes.

residuals: Official documentation is not a complete machine-readable schema; concrete supported grammar, keys, values and limits must be fixed and feasibility-checked during design.
Direct host edits have no dedicated CLI root lock, atomic commit or receipt replay protections.
Instruction compliance and fixed acceptance fixtures cannot prove arbitrary hosts or models enforce the policy.
Actual Obsidian rendering and formula runtime results are not verified by this requirements review.
Kanban requires Obsidian 1.14 or later; older application versions need an explicit unsupported-capability report.
